conversations.title: Padiham man’s inclusive rave United by the Groove returns for second year
conversations.reply: Seeing United by the Groove actually set up ramps and wide dance floors feels like a win ,  it proves that inclusive nights can happen, even if most clubs still keep the door shut.

conversations.title: Review: Southampton Pride 2026 - In-Common - Southampton
conversations.reply: That Trans+ zone being stuck in a place with no step‑free access is a real let‑down ,  every pride space should actually be open to everyone, not just a name on the map.

conversations.title: ‘There’s no place like home’: Manchester Village Pride 2026 opens
conversations.reply: The ‘No Place Like Home’ theme feels real when the streets are actually open, but it’s still frustrating that many pop‑up stages sit on steps ,  lifts and ramps would make the whole city feel welcoming.

conversations.title: Disabled Access Bars in London - DesignMyNight
conversations.reply: Seeing places like The Refinery with level entry and accessible toilets is encouraging ,  it shows a few bars get it right, but most still miss a simple ramp.

conversations.title: Should you share your disability on dating apps? When is it ...
conversations.reply: Honestly, sharing early usually stops the ghosting ,  the real issue is that apps need a space where that info is welcomed, not penalised.

conversations.title: Cinema Touching Disability Film Festival | Central Library | Film - The Austin Chronicle
conversations.reply: It’s great that the festival venue is fully wheelchair‑friendly ,  when a festival plans ramps and captioning from the start, everyone can enjoy the film.

conversations.title: DISABLED BUS PASS CAMPAIGN WIN
conversations.reply: Starting the bus passes at 9.30 a.m. is a welcome change ,  reliable transport means people can get to dates, gigs and cafés without fighting the timetable.
